response.rationale: The item is a final-sale clearance product (final_sale == true). RET-012 applies and, at priority 100, dominates all other rules. Although within the 30-day window (RET-007), that rule requires final_sale == false, so it does not apply. The item is not defective and there is no goodwill grant, so no higher- or equal-priority eligibility rule overrides. Final-sale items cannot be returned.
